title: One More Scoop
premise: A kid at the ice cream truck keeps saying 'one more scoop.' The tower goes past the clouds. A plane swerves. A seagull licks the top.
visual: Ice cream truck. A little kid holding a cone with a tower of colorful scoops rising past the clouds. A propeller plane swerving. A seagull at the top licking. The ice cream man on a tall ladder, sweating.
characterLean: Escalation gag. The show's 'something small gets huge on the drop' shape.

motion: 6-8s. Scoop. Scoop. Scoop. Camera tilts up and up past birds and clouds. The plane swerves. The seagull licks. Tilt back down: the kid takes a tiny lick of the bottom scoop. Tower wobbles.
notes: The tower never falls. The tension is that it should.
